propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() method body spans 342 lines (49% of runner.py) and must be decomposed by extracting build_agent_kwargs and telemetry blocks into a new agent_call module per ADR 0056 decision 3

Four inline kwargs-construction fragments (tool_step_limit rewrite, base dict, capabilities key, model_settings key) must be consolidated into a single build_agent_kwargs() function with explicit parameters
Post-call telemetry (success logging and spend recording) must be extracted into log_call_success() and record_call_spend() functions while preserving order-of-execution constraints
_anthropic_web_search_capabilities call site must remain in runner.py and not be relocated to agent_call.py to prevent monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, ...) patches from being silently defeated

The extraction must not require any monkeypatch repoints, must pass the full test suite unmodified, and must clear the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor while respecting the 800-LOC authoritative file ceiling
